notes: Backend URL is now dynamic instead of hardcoded in four separate files. Every install already checks this file every 6 hours for extension updates — it now also reads a new "apiUrl" field from here and keeps chrome.storage.local's backend URL in sync automatically, unless you've explicitly saved your own value in Settings → Backend URL (that's never touched). Next time the backend moves, fixing every install is a one-line edit here instead of a whole new extension version and manual reinstall.
